Each of J, K, L, M, N, O and P has an exam on a different day of the week starting on Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.Only two people have exams between J and M. L has an exam on the day immediately after J. M has an exam on Saturday. P has an exam on the day immediately after M. O has an exam on the day immediately after K but not on Friday.On which day does O have the exam?1374

Seven people, D, E, S, T, R, O and Y, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. R sits second to the right of S and E sits second to the left of T. S sits immediately to the right of E. Only one person sits between R and Y. D sits immediately to the left of E. Who sits immediately to the right of O?836

Abhinav starts from Point A and drives 7 km towards north. He then takes a left turn, drives 3 km, turns left and drives 15 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 12 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 8 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again?(All turns are 90 degree turns only unless specified.)1864
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (9 km to the west) है।

questions.question: This question is based on the following words.SET  GUT  BIN  CANIn each of the words, each vowel is changed to the letter immediately preceding it in the English alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter immediately following it in the English alphabetical order. In how many letter-clusters thus formed, will no vowel appear?
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the sixth term is related to the fifth term.8 : 70 :: 19 : ? 	:: 14 : 118

In this question, a statement is given followed by two courses of action, numbered I and II. You must assume everything in the statement to be true, and on the basis of the information given in the statement, decide which of the given courses of action logically follow(s) for pursuing.Statement:Country X has been experiencing energy crisis since 2019.Courses of Action:I. The government should announce closure of all markets and restaurants by 5:00 P.M.II. The government should work on a plan for using renewable energy sources.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Only II follows.) है।

questions.question: F is the brother of D. D is the father of E. E is the brother of A. A is the sister of B. How is F related to B?1456

A, B, C, D, K, L and M are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only two people sit between K and C when counted from the left of C. D sits third to the left of B. M sits to the immediate right of B and second to the left of K. L is not an immediate neighbour of D. Who sits third to the right of A?

Seven boxes F, G, H, I, J, K and V are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only three boxes are kept below V. Only two boxes are kept between V and J. Only I is kept above H. G is kept at some place below K and at some place above F. How many boxes are kept between K and J?

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements: Some desks are benches.All benches are chairs.No chair is a table.Conclusions:(I) Some chairs are benches.(II) Some tables are benches.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Only conclusion (I) follows.) है।
